''See also: [[Soulforge Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Soulforge is an elite, high-tier location and tool used for advanced [[Soulsmithing]]. It exists as a pocket dimension accessible via a gateway, featuring a rune-carved [[stone]] platform shaped like a [[script-circle]] that floats within a starry void. At the center of this space sits a silver altar or anvil, which serves as the focal point for creative energy and contains flickering blue [[soulfire]]. Unlike traditional forging that relies on heat to soften metal, this process involves using tools like hammers to inject a creator's will and [[Authority|authority]] into an object. The Soulforge is essential for performing high-level craftsmanship that requires imbuing items with the [[willpower]] of powerful beings, such as [[Monarchs]], which is a feat impossible with standard [[Archlord]]-level tools. The environment itself can react to the work being done, manifesting weather phenomena like [[wind]], clouds, and lightning. It is a highly specialized facility that provides an isolated space for complex creations, such as fusing [[Archlord]] [[binding|bindings]] or repairing significant weapons.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Designed and created by [[Reigan Shen]], the Soulforge is a portable, mobile location that exists as a starry world. This ultimate [[Soulsmithing]] tool contains an altar-like anvil fueled by blue [[soulfire]] and is used to manufacture [[Monarch]] weapons. By utilizing objects embedded with [[willpower]] or [[Authority|authority]], the Soulforge can increase the level of existence for any project worked there. Associated with the [[Soulsmith inheritance]] of [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]], this universally compatible site was accessed by [[Lindon]] via a [[portal]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Soulforge serves as a [[portal]] containing a gateway to another space, featuring an anvil at its very heart. Functioning as an isolated world and a place of separation, it is a location that [[Lindon]] can enter. After initially entering the Soulforge to begin his work, [[Lindon]] later returned to this realm. He utilizes the space as a place where he makes weapons.}}
